task: Add a per-tome reorder level to the catalog (new migration, API fields, owner edit) and use it in the portal's Running Low dashboard panel instead of the fixed threshold of 2.

key_reasoning.reason: Issue #8 has no acceptance criteria. Open decisions: default reorder level for existing tomes (changes what the demo dashboard shows; seed currently yields 4 tomes), inclusive vs exclusive comparison, whether clerks see the level, and whether the field is exposed on the public tomes route. Core intent is clear, gaps are design-level.

One new catalog migration; modified catalog app.ts and catalog tests; portal types.ts, Dashboard.tsx and Tomes.tsx (TomeDialog); docs api.md, architecture.md ER diagram and personas.md. About 8 modified plus 1 new across services/catalog, apps/portal and docs.
DB-Persistence (schema migration adding a column), Service/API (TOME_COLUMNS, zod newTome/tomeChanges, INSERT/UPDATE) and UI (dashboard panel and owner edit dialog). Schema change places this at L.

Closest pattern is the existing stock column plus owner-only POST/PATCH tome edit with COALESCE updates; every mechanic exists. Bumped from S to M because the shared TOME_COLUMNS list feeds the unauthenticated /public/tomes route, and the existing pattern does not cover keeping an internal field off the public response - an output-exposure divergence. Calibration: bundled M example 10203 (REST endpoint, total 15) is lighter as it has no migration or UI; this task sits higher in the M band.
